title: Micronauts #55 Marvel 1983 Huntarr Hunts Alone Butch Guice Cover
conditionDescription: Bright and clean, light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Micronauts #55 (November 1983), Marvel Comics - "Huntarr Hunts Alone." Butch Guice cover. 75 cent cover price.

Back cover: Next issue - Kaliklak! house ad by Butch Guice.

Condition: bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
